title: Remember Seedance’s 15‑second limit when planning storyboard image sequences…
content:
Remember Seedance’s 15‑second limit when planning storyboard image sequences; keep the storyboard concise enough to fit within 15 seconds.

Generate storyboard prompts by recording a voice note describing your scene in detail, then ask ChatGPT to convert that description into storyboard-generation prompts.

Use the resulting storyboard prompt in Dzine’s GPT 2.0 tool to generate the storyboard, then use that storyboard as the Storyboard reference prompt for Seedance.
